saw_lines: Fashion buyers judge a coat or knit by the photo and the fit, and they rarely read the copy before deciding.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line and the photo, before a shopper reaches the product page.
Your 17 of 30 live ads open on one line, so build two new openers from the Ribes knit and Kongsberg coat and test them against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: 17 of your 30 live ads open on one line. A new shopper sees the same opener again and has no reason to stop. Build two new openers from the Ribes knit and Kongsberg coat, and test each against it.

Your site answers how shipping works, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a first-time buyer has no answer before the click. Put the delivery timing from your shipping policy in line one of the next batch.

One exact copy runs in 17 of your 30 ads, so buyers see identical words repeatedly. Keep that copy as the base, but change the opening line and creative in each, pairing each with a different product, like the Oriane coat.

None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has no reason to trust the brand at first sight. Collect one figure, like a review count or orders shipped, and open the next ads with it.

ads_1: New openers for the Ribes knit and Kongsberg coat, tested against the fall line
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and TikTok
